answer: A marble ledger records each spawn — one identity per established sponsor every 72 hours, the child inheriting 10% of the parent's locked stake as a bond that slashes both on a missed duty. The spawn challenge embeds the parent's freshest attestation hash, so farms cannot precompute children in bulk; each birth waits on a real parent action. Forging 10,000 clones needs 10,000 established sponsors, 720,000 hours of clean duty history, and 100,000 POA of jointly slashed stake. A farm burns like a comet and finds its nadir when the marble has no room left.
